note: Draft register for Spec 073 (the keying-surface repair named by the merged outcome records of Specs 070 and 071), opened 2026-10-22 under the program's standing drafting authorization. Conventions as in Specs 042-072: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting (the registry, crosswalk and Asset A hashes recomputed; the registry's 498-id Wells map and the five codes' absence re-verified against the pinned file). The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4, per DD-038-10), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-KEYING-FAILURE-RECORD (the merged Spec 070/071 outcome and machine records state the keying failure completely and correctly), ASM-PINNED-INPUTS (registry v1, the crosswalk and Asset A v1 as pinned in spec section 2 are the surfaces the repair starts from), ASM-PUBLISHED-SOURCES (the freeze-ruled published lists are the only permissible evidence for an identity or a depiction, and are held as spec section 2 states), ASM-BLIND-ENTRY (Spec 045 section 2.4's blind-entry discipline transfers to new-row entry unchanged), ASM-GRADE-DISCIPLINE (P-F1 S4: the attested frame is the documented + corroborated rows; uncorroborated rows attest nothing and enter no measurement), ASM-NON-MUTATION (v1 files remain byte-identical; every extension is a new version with its own digest), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (frozen records are never edited and closures are never appended to by a successor), ASM-LINEAGE (agreement within the ICIT tradition is consistency, not independent corroboration, per P-F1 S3). No coverage figure appears in this register as a target: F073-C15 states the working hypothesis with its falsifier, and F073-C12 binds the reporting to measurements whatever their values. Wells 1998's in-hand state is deliberately not asserted anywhere in this register (F073-C14 records why).

claims.text: The celestial class in Asset A v2 is a measurement, never a target: a sky_cycle row exists only where a ruled published source's own words depict a sky or cycle object for that sign, and if the sources support no such rows the recorded output is that the class is empty or thin and the sky-signs question remains untestable in this form.
claims.boundary: Baseline D is Asset A v1's census: sky_cycle 0 of 187, against Spec 071's recorded TOO THIN floor of 30 members - stated in spec section 8 as a limit fixed in advance. Carried from the draft text: M4 sets v2's celestial census beside that floor as a bare comparison of numbers, not a scoring of Spec 071, whose gate never ran on v2; no row is created, split, or re-labelled to fill the class.
alternatives: treating generic round or star-like glyph shapes as celestial on the enterer's reading of the drawing (refused: that is visual judgement, excluded as evidence by F073-C05; the class fills from published words or it does not fill)
falsification_tests: inspection is the operative check: every sky_cycle row in v2 quotes its governing source's depiction wording; a sky_cycle row whose quoted wording does not depict a sky/cycle object falsifies compliance and is an entry defect

claims.text: Every source the freeze rules as governing or corroborating is exhibited in hand and pinned before entry begins; a named source not in hand closes the run as SOURCE NOT IN HAND with the source named, and no source is substituted, added, dropped, or silently narrowed at run time.
claims.boundary: The candidates and their draft-time states are spec section 2's table - including the honestly unstated one: Wells 1998's full text is resolved at record level, and its in-hand state is not asserted at this draft, so the freeze rules its standing in light of what gate 0.3 can exhibit. Carried from the draft text: discovery mid-build that a source's text is incomplete for the signs it was ruled to govern is the same closure, recorded when found.
alternatives: proceeding with the sources that happen to be in hand and noting the gap in the outcome (refused: a source set narrowed at run time changes the hierarchy's meaning per sign, invisibly; the freeze rules the set, the gate exhibits it, or the run closes)
falsification_tests: gate 0.3 is the operational test: the step-0 record exhibits each ruled source with its pin; any ruled source unexhibited closes the run as SOURCE NOT IN HAND, named

claims.text: The published lists, taken together under the freeze-ruled hierarchy, identify materially more of the corpus's attested signs than the pinned registry and Asset A now carry, so the repaired surface's keyable shares exceed the recorded baselines (26 of 31; 285 of 557) and its Wells map exceeds 498 ids.
claims.boundary: This is the design's working hypothesis (spec section 1.2), not a promised result: it is falsifiable in whole or in part, per sign and per share, and each failure mode is a recorded output of the study - a named code still NO PUBLISHED IDENTITY, a share at or below baseline, a celestial class still empty. Carried from the draft text: the hypothesis's plausibility rests on the ICIT-native published catalogue (Fuls 2023) postdating the lists the registry was built from; that is a reason to run the study, not a premise of it.
alternatives: the rival that the registry's gaps are not staleness but the published record's real limits - the ICIT tradition numbers signs its published lists nowhere depict - in which case the correct output is REPAIRED WITH NAMED SHORTFALL and the Hunt questions stay unkeyable from published sources in this form
falsification_tests: the measurements M1-M5 are the falsification test: the hypothesis fails in any limb whose measured value does not exceed its baseline, and the outcome record states each limb's result separately

claims.text: Agreement between Registry v2's ICIT identities and the Shakti corpus's numbering is reported, wherever the coverage figures appear, as consistency within the ICIT tradition - the corpus is ICIT-lineage and the repair's ICIT sources are that tradition's published lists - and never as independent corroboration of either.
claims.boundary: The fence is P-F1 S3's lineage statement applied to this study's own products, stated in spec sections 6 and 8. Carried from the draft text: the statement travels with M1-M5 into the headline block; a coverage figure quoted without it, in any product of this spec, is a reporting defect.
alternatives: presenting a completed keying surface as cross-tradition validation of the corpus's transcriptions (refused: the surface and the corpus share the ICIT ancestry the provenance audit documented; the repair tests coverage of a join, not correctness of a transcription)
falsification_tests: inspection is the operative check: the headline block and every coverage table in the execution record carry the lineage statement; its absence from any of them falsifies compliance
